ticket.title: Show a passenger profile message
ticket.description: Let passengers add a short message to their profile so it can be seen by other signed-in passengers.
requirements: Display the profile message as text.
Keep the existing profile page markup.

pr.title: Display profile messages
pr.description: Adds the passenger's profile message to the profile page.
pr.author: orbit-dev

aiReview.summary: Follow a profile message from storage to the page. Does the rendering path preserve the ticket's requirement to display it as text?

findings.title: Inspect the profile message rendering path
findings.detail: Check how the changed code inserts the message into the page, and whether the browser treats its contents as text or markup.

proposedAnswer.reason: The ticket asks for text, but this change inserts passenger-controlled content as HTML.
